items.reason: A lower-strength retinal that suits a first retinoid and gives the smoothing, firming step you asked for.
A ceramide moisturizer to cushion the skin, since your scan shows a low moisture appearance score.
A daily mineral SPF 50 is needed, since retinoids make skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: We removed the 1% retinol serum because it is high strength for someone new to retinoids and would double up with the retinal cream, which tends to cause dryness and irritation; start the retinal cream 2 nights a week at night, moisturize after, and wear the SPF every morning. If your skin stays comfortable after a couple of months, you can revisit a gentler retinol.
